# components/datetimepicker

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.ts from components/datetimepicker/datetimepicker.ts — edit the source, then `deno task docs`. -->

Import: `import { toUtcIso, utcParts, dateTimePresets, DateTimePicker } from "@tundralibs/ui/datetimepicker"`

Rendered in every variant on the catalogue (`deno task build:demos`, then `demo/index.html`). Guides: [Getting started](../UI-Getting-Started.md) · [rAPId integration](../UI-Rapid.md) · [Theming](../UI-Theming.md).

## Functions

### `toUtcIso`

```ts
toUtcIso(date: Date): string
```

A Date as `2026-10-01T09:00:00Z` (whole minutes).

### `utcParts`

```ts
utcParts(value?: string): { date: string; time: string } | undefined
```

UTC `yyyy-mm-dd` and `HH:MM` of an ISO instant.

### `dateTimePresets`

```ts
dateTimePresets(now: Date, options = …: DateTimePresetOptions): DateTimePreset[]
```

The usual three presets, computed from `now` on the server (pass the
request's clock; a fixed date in tests): tomorrow at `time` UTC, one
week from now (to the minute), and the last minute of this month
(23:59 UTC on its last day).

### `DateTimePicker`

```ts
DateTimePicker(props: DateTimePickerProps): Html
```

A date and a time as one control that posts one ISO UTC instant: a
`DatePicker` (client mode) beside a `TimePicker`, a zone chip, and
optional one-click presets. datetimepicker.js joins the parts into the
`name` input on every change, moves the time bounds when the date is
the first or last allowed day, reports a missing half through the time
picker's validity, and — with `local` — shows and edits the value in
the viewer's zone. The server must check the bounds too.

## Types

### `DateTimePreset`

A one-click value: `value` is an ISO instant (`2026-10-01T09:00:00Z`). See `dateTimePresets()`.

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | yes |  |
| `value` | `string` | yes |  |

### `DateTimePickerMessages`

Extends `TimePickerMessages`.

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `date` | `string` |  | A time without a date (or `required` and no date). Default "Pick a date." |

### `DateTimePickerProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Required: the date part is `<id>-date`, the time part `<id>-time` (its hours segment — point a label there). |
| `name` | `string` | yes | The hidden input that posts the value as one ISO UTC instant (`2026-10-01T09:00:00Z`). The parts post too, as `<name>-date` and `<name>-time` — all a no-JS page can send; `dateTimeFrom()` (`@tundralibs/ui/shared/compose`) reads either. |
| `value` | `string` |  | An ISO instant. Without a zone designator it is read as UTC. |
| `min` | `string` |  | Earliest instant accepted (ISO); earlier days are disabled, and on that day earlier times. |
| `max` | `string` |  | Latest instant accepted (ISO). |
| `step` | `number` |  | Minutes between the time slots (default 15). |
| `local` | `boolean` |  | The parts are the viewer's own wall time: the script converts the value and bounds into the browser's zone, names it in the zone chip, and posts the UTC instant. Default: the parts are UTC. |
| `zone` | `string` |  | The zone chip's text. Default `"UTC"` (in `local` mode the script replaces it with the browser's zone). |
| `presets` | `DateTimePreset[]` |  | One-click values under the fields (`dateTimePresets(now)` builds the usual three). Shown only with JS. |
| `today` | `string` |  | Today's date for the calendar (ISO `yyyy-mm-dd`); defaults to the clock. |
| `required` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `invalid` | `boolean` |  | Paint the error state (a server-side `RapidFormError` for this field). |
| `align` | `"start" | "end"` |  | Which edge the floating panels align to. |
| `messages` | `DateTimePickerMessages` |  |  |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  | Extra attributes for the root (a caller's `class` is merged). |

### `DateTimePresetOptions`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `time` | `string` |  | The time "Tomorrow" lands on, UTC `HH:MM` (default `"09:00"`). |
| `labels` | `{ tomorrow?: string; week?: string; monthEnd?: string }` |  |  |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### A link's go-live time, with presets

Posts `go_live` as one UTC instant (`2026-10-01T09:00:00Z`); read it with `dateTimeFrom(body, "go_live")`, which also joins the `-date`/`-time` parts a no-JS page sends. Build the presets from the request's clock.

```ts
DateTimePicker({
  id: "go-live",
  name: "go_live",
  value: "2026-10-01T09:00:00Z",
  min: "2026-09-30T12:00:00Z",
  today: "2026-09-30",
  presets: dateTimePresets(new Date("2026-09-30T12:00:00Z")),
})
```

### An audit-log bound in the viewer's zone

`local` shows and edits the viewer's wall time and names their zone; the posted value is still UTC.

```ts
DateTimePicker({ id: "log-from", name: "from", local: true, step: 60, today: "2026-09-30" })
```

## CSS hooks

Classes defined by `components/datetimepicker/datetimepicker.css` — structural, token-driven; override from an unlayered stylesheet (see [Theming](../UI-Theming.md)):

`.datepicker__trigger`, `.datetimepicker`, `.datetimepicker--invalid`, `.datetimepicker__fields`, `.datetimepicker__preset`, `.datetimepicker__presets`, `.js`

## Behaviour

`components/datetimepicker/datetimepicker.js` ships in `ui.js` (delegated on `document`, re-initialised after a rAPId swap).

Attributes it reads or writes: `data-datepicker`, `data-datepicker-max`, `data-datepicker-min`, `data-datepicker-start`, `data-datetime-preset`, `data-datetime-value`, `data-datetimepicker`, `data-datetimepicker-local`, `data-datetimepicker-max`, `data-datetimepicker-min`, `data-datetimepicker-ready`, `data-datetimepicker-required`, `data-datetimepicker-zone`, `data-msg-date`, `data-msg-required`, `data-segment`, `data-timepicker`, `data-timepicker-error`, `data-timepicker-max`, `data-timepicker-min`, `data-timepicker-value`.

Events: `datepicker:refresh`, `rapid:swapped`, `timepicker:refresh`.
